verdict.rationale: Unity documents broad programmatic surfaces: public scripting APIs for finer control and customization, Editor extension and AssetDatabase APIs, and command-line launch and automation of the Editor. A new experimental Unity CLI adds `unity <command>`/`unity eval` to drive the Editor directly, plus an MCP mode for agents. Nothing in the evidence states that every UI action is exposed programmatically, and the newest agent-facing CLI is experimental while the in-editor MCP server is deprecated. Missing for 10: explicit documented UI/API parity, a stable (non-experimental) agent-facing CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.
